{
  "name": "session-todo",
  "version": "0.2.36",
  "description": "A live todo pane for the session: the agent keeps it current through a tool, you read and tick it without asking.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Jesper Sahlin",
    "url": "https://github.com/jepperip"
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "How the Todo pane is coloured: classic (the terminal's green, yellow, red), cyberpunk (neon green and purple), or a standard palette.",
      "default": "classic",
      "options": [
        "classic",
        "cyberpunk",
        "dracula",
        "nord",
        "solarized",
        "gruvbox",
        "monokai",
        "catppuccin",
        "tokyo-night",
        "one-dark"
      ]
    },
    "compact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Compact rows",
      "description": "Drop the blank line between items in the Todo pane.",
      "default": false
    },
    "layout": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Layout",
      "description": "What shows where. auto: the band above the prompt while the Todo pane is closed, and the pane opens on its own at the first items. both: the band always, the pane as in auto. band: the band always, the pane only when you open it. pane: no band, the pane as in auto.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "both",
        "band",
        "pane"
      ]
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Toast when an item needs you",
      "description": "Show a toast when a step starts waiting on you: the agent marked it blocked, or one of yours is up. The band and the pane show it in your colour either way.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
